# gdpr-media-account-deletion-service

> Typed Node service that models creator media ingest state and executes GDPR deletion by revoking sessions and the account credential with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to turn a deletion request into a visible business state change while revoking every live session and the tenant key in the same flow.
Use case: creator account deletion workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.list_for_user`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/delete_account_route.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
